items.title: Heavy Chalk Shorter Than -250 (1.40 Decimal) Capped at Medium Confidence
items.detail: Per explicit brief instructions to focus high-confidence recommendations inside -250 to +10000 American odds (1.40 to 101.00 decimal), heavy favorites whose fair moneyline price is shorter than -250 remain fully priced across all markets in every sport table, with match-winner confidence capped at medium rather than high.
